provenance.adaptedValues: ADVERSARIAL FIXTURE, pinned so the redaction rule is exercised against a real file rather than only an inline literal. The provider publishes no credential-bearing description; this one is constructed to prove that if a description ever carries credential-shaped words (password, token, secret, api key, authorization, private key, credential, bearer), the normalizer withholds it entirely instead of mapping it into data.failureReason — which migration 0031 would otherwise have to reject at the database boundary.
